answer: Resist sybils with capability fingerprinting: each epoch, agents complete fresh benchmark tasks under time pressure, and their pattern of strengths, errors, and timing becomes a fingerprint. A thousand clones run by one operator share one model and one garden of training data, so their fingerprints cluster like cedar cuttings from a single tree — identical quirks and blind spots. Matching fingerprints are quarantined as one identity, so cloning buys no extra influence, only exposure, and an ivory registry of fingerprints makes every match public and checkable.
